text:
Tamara: Heads up — product team visiting Charlotte (uptown) next Wed evening. Need a casual spot for ~6pm, party of 6, mixed veg/meat. Walkable from 20 N Tryon office. Any local recs?
Raj: Mert's Heart & Soul is a classic for southern comfort and decent veggie sides, prob a 10-min walk.
Emma: If you want tacos/fajitas, Superica is solid and pretty group-friendly. :taco:
Lina: For tapas/shared plates, 'The Roost' on Tryon has good small plates and a chill vibe. Not a huge menu but works for groups.
Todd: If y'all are okay with slightly pricier, Fahrenheit (rooftop) has a great view — might be a 12-15m walk.
Mei: Korean BBQ option: Soju & Seoul on 6th st — big tables, lots of veg banchan, great for groups. Highly recommend.
Raj: +1 Soju & Seoul. Call ahead for a group of 6, they sometimes seat slower walk-ins.
Olivia: Quick poll — react with an emoji: :one: Southern (Mert's)  :two: Korean (Soju & Seoul)  :three: Mexican (Superica)  :four: Tapas/Rooftop
Lina: :two: :thumbsup:
Mei: :two:
Raj: :one: but leaning :two:
Emma: :three: (if anyone's craving tacos)
Tamara: Looks like Korean is winning. Linh, can you book if it's available? Also we have one gluten-free + one pescatarian in the group.
Linh: On it — calling Soju & Seoul now. Any preference for indoor vs window seating?
Tamara: Indoor is fine. Earlier is better — 6:15pm?
Linh: Reservation confirmed: Soju & Seoul — Wed 6:15pm, party of 6. Confirmation #SJS-4521. Note: they can accommodate gluten-free (rice bowls) and pescatarian options.
Linh: Reservation details pasted below:
```
Soju & Seoul
6th St, Uptown Charlotte
Wed 6:15pm — party of 6
Conf: SJS-4521
Phone: (704) 555-0192
Notes: GF + pescatarian ok; request seating near BBQ vents
```
Raj: Amazing, thanks Linh! :raised_hands:
Olivia: Added to calendar.
calendar-bot: Event added to #team-calendar — "Wed dinner: Soju & Seoul (6:15pm)".
Tamara: Sweet, appreciate the quick help y'all. See you Wednesday! :smile:
